The file has one theorem, geometric_optimizer_producer, with no simp lemmas, simp attributes or new definitions. I read all of it. I also looked up crossingCount_enlargedRectangle_scale in GridCollar.lean and collarWeight/collarWeightSum in CollarWeights.lean.

The only simp use is `simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hb` at line 96. It rearranges `8*(r+(j+1))` into `8*(r+1+j)` using Nat AC lemmas. The AC lemmas are permutation lemmas, which simp rewrites only in a fixed term order, so I found no cycle. The weight is the complete-lemma form `crossingCount_enlargedRectangle_scale`, which is a bound rather than a simp-normal-form rewrite. I did not run Lean, so I can't say whether this call is fragile.

I don't think this justifies a simp-interface finding. The `omega`-style arithmetic used elsewhere would be an alternative, and it would be a style choice rather than a missing or misoriented simp lemma. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, no competing rules and no unwanted expansion.
